target: Local production-built Web SPA on loopback in headless Edge.
network: External HTTP and WebSockets blocked; API requests intercepted by synthetic fixtures.
assertions_and_observations: Tenant admin creates a flow definition with keyboard operation; the create payload is scoped to the fixture company.
The editor saves a draft version, then updates its status to approved.
Company availability is enabled by keyboard and writes a tenant-scoped permission.
Intent mapping is created for the same company and flow definition.
Flow definition reads include the tenant company filter; tenant company picker is absent.
At 390px viewport width, document content remains 390px without horizontal overflow.
limitations: This verifies the built Web UI and intercepted request contracts only; no API/Cloud authentication, PostgreSQL persistence, private CRM destination, customer voice provider, or live call was exercised.
All external network access was blocked.
